mentions.name: HackerFlow
mentions.description: A feature-rich native Hacker News reader app with an Android version on the Play Store and an iOS version in development. It offers an improved UI, a history so users never lose a story, advanced bookmarking for saving stories and comments into custom folders, and account login for upvoting stories and writing comments (currently broken).
mentions.audience: Existing Hacker News reader apps have too few useful features, bad UI, or both.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a feature rich native Hacker News app. I tried out all HN Reader on the App Store but sadly they either have to few useful features, bad UI or both so I decided to build one myself.
mentions.author: alefalfa
